name: Dale: out here they notice (day-3 hint, no lights named)
notes: N1110 (pace, critic 2). Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp StepHint) on day 3 when nothing has warned yet, in a quiet moment (not during a happening or a rest, not driving, not in a window, 10 game minutes or more after the night began and after Dale last spoke). Same rule as attention_hint_dale but naming no lights, since none have been seen yet. The lamp line comes 16 s after the first, as in attention_hint_dale.

beats.text: Do not stare at anything out there too long. Out here they notice. Over.
Dale, on the walkie: do not stare at anything out there too long. Out here they notice.
If one comes close, kill the lamp and hold still. The small ones look right past you. Over.
